item.description: “It’s going to be a huge party,” Bad Bunny said.

item.title: Lamar CISD officers on leave amid independent investigation
item.description: Lamar Consolidated ISD has placed two of its officers on administrative leave pending an investigation by an independent third party, but the district has not provided any details about the nature of the investigation.

item.title: Mary J. Blige's new Lifetime movie "Be Happy" stars Htown's Cameron J. Ross
item.description: New Lifetime movie 'Be Happy' premieres this Saturday, starring Tisha Campbell and Cameron J. Ross. A story of love, self-discovery, and second chances.

item.title: Attorney General Ken Paxton asks judge to shut down Muslim advocacy group CAIR
item.description: Ken Paxton is asking a judge to declare that CAIR is a foreign terrorist organization and transnational criminal organization.

item.title: Search for Savannah Guthrie's mother: Officials say no suspects, announce $50K reward
item.description: “We just want her home, and to find a way to get to the bottom of all of this, just like you do," the Pima County sheriff said.

item.title: Five puppies, four dogs, and three residents rescued from Spring house fire
item.description: Major house fire in Spring, Texas ends with all residents and several puppies safely rescued. Quick response by first responders praised.

item.title: Rabbi shot in Bondi Beach terror attack returns back to Houston
item.description: Rabbi Leibel Lazaroff, who was seriously wounded during a terror attack at Bondi Beach in Sydney, has returned home to Houston, where he was greeted by family and friends, and will continue to recover from his injuries.

item.title: 12-year-old girl rescued from Galveston hotel after being kidnapped, police say
item.description: A 12-year-old girl was rescued from a Galveston hotel after she was allegedly abducted by who police call a “serial sexual predator.”

item.title: I-10 East eastbound partially reopened after sinkhole filled
item.description: All eastbound lanes of the I-10 East Freeway at Federal Road are closed due to a sinkhole that formed from a water leak, authorities said.
